title: Tehseen S. Poonawalla v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Tehseen S. Poonawalla v. Union of India, (2018) 9 SCC 501
content.holding: Issued exhaustive preventive, remedial, and punitive guidelines against mob lynching and mob violence, urging Parliament to create a dedicated, separate penal offence for lynching. This judgment directly inspired Section 103(2) BNS.
content.relevance: Direct legislative provenance for Section 103(2) BNS group identity murder.
